Client Data

group LIGHT_CTL_CLIENT_DATA

Data types and structures used by client data process callbacks.

Defines

LIGHT_CTL_CLIENT_STATUS 0

Uses light_ctl_client_status_t.

LIGHT_CTL_CLIENT_STATUS_TEMPERATURE 1

Uses light_ctl_client_status_temperature_t.

LIGHT_CTL_CLIENT_STATUS_TEMPERATURE_RANGE 2

Uses light_ctl_client_status_temperature_range_t.

LIGHT_CTL_CLIENT_STATUS_DEFAULT 3

Uses light_ctl_client_status_default_t.
